title: ZOE client benchmark result
description: One run of the client benchmark: ZEO.ClientStorage and the native client, zoe.zeo.ClientStorage, through the storage API and without ZODB, against the same servers, on one machine, with one Python build. Results are numbers about a synthetic corpus, never data.

workers.description: One item per Python process of the row that imported ZODB: the process of each round in the threads mode, the process of each worker in the processes mode.

gil_enabled.description: sys._is_gil_enabled() when the process ended; true on a build with the GIL.

gil_enabled_by.description: The modules that turned the GIL back on in the process, from the warnings of CPython. Empty on a build with the GIL.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema. A change that a reader of the previous version cannot read increments it.

machine.description: The machine that ran the benchmark, as in the results of the harness. It holds no host name, user name or path.

python.description: The Python build that ran both clients.

free_threaded.description: True for a build without the GIL, such as 3.14t.

gil_enabled_by.description: The modules that turned the GIL back on in a process of the run, over all rows. Empty on a build with the GIL.

software.description: The version of each distribution and server in the run, keyed by name: ZEO and zoedb are the versions of both clients.

started.description: When the run started, in UTC.

commit.description: The ZOE commit of the harness, or null when it is not known.

objects.description: The objects that each worker loads in a cold or warm round.

commits.description: The commits of 100 records that each worker makes in a commit round. Optional: results without it stay valid.

dirty.description: True when the tree of the harness held changes that the commit does not; false when it held none; null when git fails. Optional: results without it stay valid, but only false is publishable (ADR 0054).

rows.description: One entry per client, server, shape, workload and record size.

server.description: zoe-serve: zoe serve. zeo: a ZEO 6 server on a FileStorage.

mode.description: threads: the workers are threads of one process on one client. processes: each worker is a process with its own client.

workload.description: cold: loads with no cache. warm: the same loads after a reopen on the cache file of the cold run of the same client; the open and its verification count. commit: commits of 100 new records.

record_size.description: The size of each record, in bytes.

calls_per_second.description: The calls of all workers of a round, divided by the time of the round; the median of the rounds. A call is one loadBefore, or one commit of 100 records.

p50_seconds.description: The median time of a call, over the calls of all rounds.

p99_seconds.description: The 99th percentile of the same times.

client_cpu_per_object_seconds.description: The CPU time of the client processes of a round, user and system, divided by the objects loaded or stored; the median of the rounds.

rounds.description: The number of rounds. The rounds of both clients interleave.

spread.description: The highest minus the lowest calls_per_second of the rounds, divided by their median.

traverse.description: The traverse rows: one entry per client and server. The harness writes a tree of PersistentMappings through ZODB, the root of the store with 20 children for each node over 3 levels, and leaves of 1 KB of random bytes. Each round, a new process opens a DB on a client with an empty cache, calls cacheMinimize() and walks the tree depth first. Optional: results without it stay valid.

prefetch_references.description: The setting prefetch-references of the native client; null for ZEO.ClientStorage.

walk_seconds.description: The time of one walk; the median of the rounds.

server_loads.description: The loads that zoe serve counted in a round, from the open of the client to its close; the median of the rounds. null against the ZEO server, which counts no loads.

rounds.description: The number of rounds. The rounds of the three clients interleave.

spread.description: The longest minus the shortest walk of the rounds, divided by their median.
